  [Title] Hello Callout!
  [Heading2] Overview of callouts
  [FirstParagraph]   Warning
  [BodyText] Callouts provide a simple way to attract attention, for example, to this warning.
  
  [FirstParagraph]  
  [FirstParagraph]   This is Important
  [BodyText] Danger, callouts will really improve your writing.
  
  [BodyText]  
  [FirstParagraph]   Note
  [BodyText] Note that there are five types of callouts, including: note, tip, warning, caution, and important.
  
  [BodyText]  
  [FirstParagraph]   Tip With Caption
  [BodyText] This is an example of a callout with a caption.
  
  [Heading2] Callout with markup
  [FirstParagraph]   Caption with formatted text, like function_name()
  [BodyText] This is an example of a callout with a caption containing special formatting and characters.
  
  [FirstParagraph]  
  [FirstParagraph]   Expand To Learn About Collapse
  [BodyText] This is an example of a ‘collapsed’ caution callout that can be expanded by the user. You can use collapse=true to collapse it by default or collapse=false to make a collapsible callout that is expanded by default.
  
  [BodyText]  
  [FirstParagraph] Exercise
  [BodyText] You can also use a plain callout class to get a simple callout treatment.
